name: Reeve Halda
text: An orc reeve who keeps the peace in Westhold, a settlement dug out of a fallen city's gatehouse, and pays those who help her keep it.

name: Factor Imre
text: A gnome trader with business all along the border, and never enough couriers he can trust.

name: Warden Osk
text: An old goblin warden who watches the passes for raiders and paladins.

name: Ysolde the Necromancer
text: She keeps the crypt under the old chapel, and she can call the dead back up out of it, for a price or a service.

name: Brother Aldo
text: A grey-robed priest of the god of death. His mortuary can send the dead back, if the god is paid, in crowns or in service.

name: Vashti of the Pits
text: An elf necromancer who works the plague pits under Cinderhold. She was one of his, once; she does not say how willingly.

name: Mother Skrell
text: A goblin death priest who keeps Gutterwick's mortuary. The god of death takes crowns, or service.

name: Elder Gorvash
text: An old orc who leads Cinderhold's council. He remembers the binding, and fears whoever finds a way to use it first.

name: Foreman Tikka
text: A goblin who runs Gutterwick's work gangs and road crews, and pays for anything that keeps the roads open.
